content: Paawulo agaluka omu gihugo ch'eMakedoniya na ech'eBugiriki
Entambala yabeere yaahwa eyo eEfeeso, Paawulo agusha abemeezi haguma, anabaseeza omurhima. Abaseezera, ava aja omu gihugo ch'eMakedoniya.
Alenga mw'echo gihugo, abwira abemeezi ebinwa binene by'okubakomeza omurhima. Buzinda aja omu gihugo ch'eBugiriki.
Amala yo myeezi esharhu. Abeere akola aja omu chombo ch'okuja omu gihugo ch'eSuriya, ayunva omwazi okw'aBayaahudi bamujiriire kaligi. Kwarhuma ahiga kugaluka kugerera omu gihugo ch'eMakedoniya.
Abaherekezaga Paawulo baliiri Sopateeri mugala wa Piiro, w'eBeroya; Arisitariko na Sekundo b'eTesalonika; Gaayo w'eDerebe; Timoteyo, Tikiko na Torofimo baliiri b'eAziya.
Abo bantu barhurhanga embere gurhulingira eTorowa.
Rhwabo neerhu, enyuma z'esiku z'edinye y'emigati nzira chachu, rhwaja omu chombo gurhenga eFiripi. Siku erhaano zabeere zahwa, rhwabashimaana eTorowa. Rhwabeera yo siku mushanvu.
Paawulo afuula Eutiko
Egolo ly'olusiku lw'eSaabato, rhwashigaanana kugabaana omugati,
na Paawulo ayigiriza abantu. Agendeerera kuganiira n'abantu guhika ahagarhi k'obudufu, kwenge ali kwaneene kugenda olusiku lwakulikiraga.
Rhwalemaga rhwabugaanana omu gorofa ebusiika. Omoola mwaliiri amatara manene.

Muzaana muguma oyirikwa Eutiko, aliiri ayikeere oku dirisha. Paawulo aliiri eyi amaleehya enyigirizo zaage, oyo muzaana arhoolwa n'ero linene. Ero lyarhuma oyo muzaana arhoga gurhengera oku gorofa lya gasharhu. Babeere bashonda kumuyinamula, bashimaana afiire.
Paawulo ava achima, achikabula oku ye n'okumubagalira. Ababwira ntya: «Murhayuubahaga, bulaala azeene!»
Enyuma w'ebyo, Paawulo ashuba kuzamuukira omu gorofa. Achagulanga omugati anagulya ko, agendeerera kuganiira bweneene, kugera emiseke. Ayuusize, agenda.
Abantu baherekeza oyo muzaana emwabo eyi ali mugumaguma. Baseezwa omurhima bweneene.
Paawulo abalamira eMileto
Rhwabo, rhwarhanga kuja omu gishagala ch'eHasoosi n'echombo. Eyo munda, rhwali rhukwaneene gurhoola Paawulo, bulaala alishondere kuja yo n'amagulu.
Abeere arhushigaana eHasoosi, rhwamuhira omu chombo, n'okuja eMitileeni.
Olusiku lwakulikiraga, rhwarhenga yo, rhwagendekera oku nyanja, rhwagera embere z'echizimba ch'eKiyo. Olusiku lwa gasharhu, rhwahika oku chizimba ch'eSamoosi. N'olusiku luzinda, rhwahika eMileto.
Paawulo arhashondaga kuyimanga eEfeeso omu gihugo ch'eAziya, y'arhaheza ebishanji. Aliiri abangula y'aba eYerusaleema olusiku lw'edinye y'ePendekosite akaba byagalikeene.
Paawulo aseezera abashamuka b'echigusho ch'abemeezi b'eEfeeso
Paawulo abeere ali eMileto, arhuma abantu eEfeeso guhamagala abashamuka b'echigusho ch'abemeezi.
Babeere baahika aha ali, ababwira ntya: «Mwabo muyinji gurhe nalamire haguma nenyu, amango nahikaga muno gihugo ch'eAziya, gurhengera olusiku lurhanzi.
Nakoleere Nnaweerhu omu bwirhonzi booshi, omu miziga, n'ahagarhi k'ebigeregezo byampikiraga elugulu wa kaligi k'aBayaahudi.
Muyinji oku nta mwazi nababishire. Aliko, nabayamagaziize n'okubayigiriza ngasi chintu chaliiri ch'obulagiirire, omu nshimaanano z'abantu n'omu nju zenyu.
Babe Bayaahudi, babe Bagiriki, naliiri nababwira oku baleke ebyaaha, bahindamukire Nnamahanga, banayemeere Nnaweerhu Yeesu Krisitu.
Leero nyoono, okubona oku nshwekerwe na Muuka-Mutagatiifu, naaja eYerusaleema, buzira kumenya echampikira yo.
Aliko, nyinji konyine oku, omu ngasi gishagala nagerere mo, Muuka-Mutagatiifu aliiri anyeereka oku eminyororo n'amalibuko bindingire.

Sy'aliko ntaganja akalamo kaani nka chintu ch'akamaro emwani. Echinashonda chonyine, kuli kumala bwinja olugenzi lwani n'akaasi Nnaweerhu Yeesu ampaaga k'oguhamiiriza oMwazi Mwinja g'olukogo lwa Nnamahanga.
«Naliiri nazungula ahagarhi kenyu mweshi eyi ndi nayaamagaza obwime bwa Nnamahanga. Aliko bunoola, nyoono nyinji oku nta muguma wenyu wachimbona ko.
Cho girhumire nababwira byo zeene oku eshagama yenyu erhachindi ko,
kwenge nababaliire byooshi Nnamahanga ashondere, buzira kubabisha echintu.

Mujaage mwachilanga mwenyine haguma n'echigusho chooshi Muuka-Mutagatiifu abaheere mube bimangizi baacho. Ntyo, mulange echo chigusho ch'abemeezi ba Nnamahanga echi achiheere omu gusheesha eshagama y'oMugala.
Nyoono nyinji oku hano mala kugenda, banyambwe bakalihire baja ahagarhi kenyu, barhanafiira echigusho ch'abemeezi obonjo.
Na kandi, ahagarhi kenyu harhengerera abantu baderha ebinwa birhali by'okuli yi baarhuma abemeezi babakulikira.
Boboola, muchilange eyi munali mwayibuka oku namalire myaaka esharhu, obudufu n'ezuuba ntaluhaga guhanuula omu miziga ngasi muguma wenyu.
«Na bunoola, namabahira omu maboko ma Nnamahanga n'omu bulanzi bw'omwazi g'olukogo lwage, gugwerhe obuhashe b'okubakuza n'okubaha agashambala haguma n'abantu baage booshi agishogere.
Ntagifiijaga efuranga changwa ehooro, abe myambalo y'omuntu.
Muyinji mwenyine oku nakolaga n'amaboko maani nyenyine yi mbona ebi rhwalilagire ko, nyoono n'abalimperekeeze.

Mw'ebyo byooshi najiraga, nalibayeerekere oku bihemere gukola n'obushiru ntya yi rhurhabaale abarhagwerhe misi, omu kuyibuka ebinwa bya Nnaweerhu Yeesu. Aderhaga yenyine ntya: ‹Hali mugisho munene omu guhaana kulusha okuyankirira.›»
Paawulo abeere amala kuderha ebyoola, afukama haguma nabo booshi, asaliira.
Booshi baaja barhondera kulaka bweneene, bamuhoobera n'okumuseezera.
Balibabeezwe bweneene, bulaala aliderhere oku barhagachimubona ko. Baava bamuherekeza guhika aha echombo chaliiri.

footnotes.text: 20.7 eChinwa cha Nnamahanga bayandikaga omu chigiriki chiderhere hano: «Guchagulanga omugati.» Kuli gushonda kuderha: «Okulya haguma ebiryo bya Nnaweerhu.»
